answer.rationale: Deploy the proven simplified onboarding path for SMB self-serve accounts. It has durable evidence of stronger activation, faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention, supporting sustainable qualified revenue without the known retention downside of promotional pricing. This will not directly resolve price objections among existing accounts, so its impact on the current churn spike remains uncertain; however, discounting is explicitly contraindicated as a sustainable response by exp_73.
